requirements.title: Say how an unattended af-spec run ended
requirements.rationale: A controller reads the result file and nothing else of the session, so the file's shape is the contract between the two.

criteria.action: for any result document of a run that wrote a package that validates, accept it: `skill` is `af-spec`, `mode` is `unattended`, `outcome` is `written`, `package` holds `spec_dir`, `spec_id`, `spec_name`, `title`, `status` and `profile`, `branch` and `head` are non-empty strings, `pushed` is `true`, and `decisions`, `escalated` and `remaining_scopes` are lists
criteria.contract: validating the document against the schema returns no error

check.pseudocode: in specification/schemas/af_spec_result_test.go (new), one table of documents the schema accepts, each the base document with a change: {unchanged; decisions holding {number: 1, decision, reason} and {number: 2, …}; escalated holding {finding, decision}; outcome 'invalid' with status 'draft' and failing_rules ['C5', 'json_schema']; outcome 'push_failed' with pushed false and a reason; outcome 'push_failed' with pushed false, status 'draft', a reason and failing_rules ['C5']; each of refused_input, refused_dirty, refused_already_specified and refused_spec_root with a reason and no package, decisions, escalated or remaining_scopes; refused_input with a reason and a package of status 'sealed'; refused_input with a reason and a package of status 'superseded'}: assert schema.Validate(document) returns no error

criteria.condition: a result document's `outcome` is `refused_input`, `refused_dirty`, `refused_already_specified` or `refused_spec_root` and it carries a non-empty `reason`
criteria.action: accept the document without `package`, `decisions`, `escalated` and `remaining_scopes`, and with `pushed` either `true` or `false`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns no error, with or without a `package` member, whose `status` may then be any of `draft`, `active`, `sealed`, `superseded` and `archived`

criteria.condition: a result document lacks `skill`, `mode`, `outcome`, `branch`, `head` or `pushed`, or its `skill` is not `af-spec`, its `mode` is not `unattended`, its `outcome` is none of `written`, `invalid`, `push_failed`, `refused_input`, `refused_dirty`, `refused_already_specified`, `refused_spec_root`, `refused_number` and `refused_findings`, its `branch` or `head` is empty, its `pushed` is not a boolean, or it carries a member the schema does not name
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error whose text names the member that is missing, wrong or unknown

check.pseudocode: in specification/schemas/af_spec_result_test.go, one table of documents the schema refuses, each the base document with one change and the member the error must name: {skill removed; mode removed; outcome removed; branch removed; head removed; pushed removed; skill 'af-impl'; mode 'watched'; outcome 'done'; branch ''; head ''; pushed 'yes'; an added member 'notes'; outcome 'refused_dirty' without reason; outcome 'refused_input' with reason ''; outcome 'push_failed' with pushed false and no reason; package removed; package without each of its six members in turn; package.status 'sealed'; package.profile 'small'; decisions removed; escalated removed; remaining_scopes removed; outcome 'invalid' with status 'draft' and no failing_rules; outcome 'invalid' with status 'draft' and failing_rules []; outcome 'invalid' with status 'active' and failing_rules ['C5']; failing_rules ['C5'] on the written base; pushed false on the written base; outcome 'invalid', status 'draft', failing_rules ['C5'] and pushed false; outcome 'push_failed' with a reason and pushed true; decisions [{number: 0, decision, reason}]; a decision without number, without decision and without reason in turn; escalated [{finding}] and [{decision}]}: assert schema.Validate(document) returns an error, and that the error's text names the member the case gives

criteria.condition: a result document's `outcome` begins `refused_` or is `push_failed` and it has no `reason`, or an empty one
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names `reason`

criteria.condition: a result document's `outcome` is `written`, `invalid` or `push_failed` and it lacks `package`, `decisions`, `escalated` or `remaining_scopes`, or its `package` lacks one of `spec_dir`, `spec_id`, `spec_name`, `title`, `status` and `profile`, has a `status` that is neither `draft` nor `active`, or a `profile` that is neither `full` nor `lite`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names the missing or wrong member

criteria.condition: a result document's `outcome` is `invalid` and it has no `failing_rules`, an empty list of them, or a `package.status` other than `draft`, or its `outcome` is `written` and it carries `failing_rules`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names `failing_rules` or `status`

criteria.condition: a result document's `outcome` is `written` or `invalid` and its `pushed` is `false`, or its `outcome` is `push_failed` and its `pushed` is `true`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names `pushed`

criteria.condition: an entry of `decisions` lacks `number`, `decision` or `reason` or has a `number` below 1, or an entry of `escalated` lacks `finding` or `decision`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns an error that names the entry's missing or wrong member

requirements.title: Say what the number, the draft and the defect left
requirements.rationale: The caller that asked for a draft has to learn the one call that activates it, and the caller that reported a defect whether the fault was found in the code.

criteria.action: for any result document of a run given `--number`, `--no-activate` or `--defect`, accept it: an outcome `refused_number` with a `reason`; a `written` document whose `package.status` is `draft` and whose `activate_with` is `speca <spec_id> --status active`; a document whose `package.profile` is `lite` and that carries the boolean `fault_located`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns no error

requirements.title: Say what a split left over, and answer each finding of a revision
requirements.rationale: A later run is started from a remaining scope's text, and a reviewer reads the reply to the finding they wrote; both come out of the result, and the findings file goes in.

criteria.action: for any result document of a run that split its input or revised a draft, accept it: `remaining_scopes` holds entries of `name`, a `snake_case` package name, `summary` and `text`; `replies` holds entries of `id`, `action`, which is `changed` or `unchanged`, and `text`; and an outcome `refused_findings` carries a `reason`
criteria.contract: validating the document returns no error
